audit.why: 47.1% over 1690 games supports TRICKY 7/10. Level 1 is yours on range (815 Q vs his 650 Rake and 575 Q); the lane tilts at 6 and with the first lethality item; two items flips back with Zhonya's.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every one of the seven phases[N].side values disagreed with the content layer and the packet levelChart, and all seven whys were Orianna boilerplate that never named a Talon ability.
audit.why: Full layer read Talon x4 then Skill x3; content and packet both read Orianna, Skill, Skill, Skill, Talon, Talon, Orianna. The page answered 'who wins Level 1' twice, differently.
audit.corrected: All seven sides aligned to the content layer, ratings recurved to match, and every why rewritten to explain the new verdict from the kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no number, and Assassin's Path — the ability that makes every wall an entrance — was never mentioned in any cooldown or don't field.
audit.why: Rake is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7, Noxian Diplomacy 8/7.5/7/6.5/6 and leaps only from outside melee at 575. Assassin's Path costs 0 mana on a 0s cooldown; the cooldown lives on the terrain, not the spell.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns; the wall-hop threat written into dontsFull[2].d and phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: No punishable window was stated with a number.
audit.why: Rake at 9s rank 1 is the lane's green light — the return blades carry most of his poke, and your Q is 7s falling to 3s, so you get casts he cannot answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] told the reader to buy the stopwatch 'the moment Zed hits 6' — the wrong champion entirely.
audit.why: Talon is the enemy and his level 6 Shadow Assault is exactly the stopwatch trigger.

edits.before: Ball on the wave, autos on his face — your passive-stacked autos win level 1 against almost every mid. Place, don't throw.
edits.after: Your Q reaches 815 against his 650 Rake and 575 Q — place the ball on his last-hit spot and stack passive autos.

edits.before: Q-W online: the classic chunk combo. Trade it on his last-hits and keep the ball where his approach must cross it.
edits.after: Q-W online, but Rake's return blades chip you back — trade on his last-hits and stand off the return line.

edits.before: E completes the kit: ball-on-self beats his engage, ball-on-wave farms, ball-on-him threatens. The chess match begins.
edits.after: E completes the kit and ball-on-self answers his 575 Q leap, but his combo weight climbs too. Even ground for now.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-W every wave contact now. The Dissonance field controls every step he takes near the ball.
edits.after: Lost Chapter steadies your mana and the poke trades stay level — he is not lethal until Shadow Assault lands.

edits.before: Shockwave online — your lane presence doubles without casting anything. Every wave he contests is a potential flip.
edits.after: Shadow Assault plus lethality is his window, and Assassin's Path costs him nothing — every wall is an entrance.

edits.before: Luden's spike: Q-W chunks a third of his bar. Shove, rotate, and let the ball-delivery threat run the river fights.
edits.after: Lethality lets him execute you on sight and hop walls to side lanes — hold Zhonya's, shove, and track him.

edits.before: Late Ori is the teamfight: protect-ball on your diver, shockwave their clump, and dissonance the choke they retreat through.
edits.after: Two items in you pull ahead: Zhonya's eats Shadow Assault and Shockwave gathers a clump his single-target dive cannot.

edits.before: - Talon Rake: matchup-defining — The boomerang return is most of his lane damage — stand off the return line. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Command: Protect like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Rake: 9s at rank 1 and 7s maxed — the return blades are most of his lane damage, so stand off the return line and step up while it is down. - Noxian Diplomacy is 8s. - Assassin's Path costs nothing, so no wall is ever safe.

edits.before: From Luden's you run rivers: shove the wave, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Protect-ball on your jungler doubles every gank.
edits.after: From Luden's you run rivers: shove the wave, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Ball on your jungler adds shield, armour and MR to the dive.

edits.before: Ball on his farm path, Q-W the last-hit contact, auto-weave once, and recall the ball — three-second trades his combo math can't answer.
edits.after: Drop W where he must land — the Dissonance slow catches him between Assassin's Path hops and his walk out, so the dive costs him.

edits.before: Poking with the ball stranded at max range when his engage is up — an Orianna without her ball is a Doran's Ring with legs.
edits.after: A third cast leaves the ball 815 away while his Q leaps 575 off a wall-hop — you will have no shield left when he lands.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Luden's Companion into Sorcerer's, then Shadowflame and Rabadon's. Zhonya's vs dive — buy the stopwatch the moment Zed hits 6.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Luden's Companion into Sorcerer's, then Shadowflame and Rabadon's. Zhonya's vs dive — buy the stopwatch the moment Talon hits 6.

notes: The full-layer chart disagreed with the content layer on all seven rows; sides, ratings and whys were moved together to match win[0..6] and the packet. The kit file puts a 'knockup' flag on Rake; Riot's description says the returning blades deal bonus damage and slow, with no displacement — trusting the description, no knockup claim was written and no Shockwave-into-knockup synergy was asserted. breakdown.carry, breakdown.feeding, ahead and breakdown.early remain structurally templated; nothing Talon-specific was verifiable to ground a replacement without inventing.
